The '''Onatos sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].

==History==
A [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] tribe lived on a mountainous world in the Onatos sector, and modified a number of [[X-1 Viper]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], for use as transports on their world.<ref name="SGTG">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
